scripts.dev: npm-run-all --parallel serve script-watcher watch:c:wasm watch:remote:wasm watch:nim:js watch:haxe:js watch:cppia:script
scripts.build:remote:release: npm run build:remote:wasm && vite build && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/remote/out && cp examples/remote/out/main.js examples/remote/out/main.wasm examples/www/dist/examples/remote/out/
scripts.build:librl: make DEV=1 wasm && npm run build:js-binding
scripts.build:examples:release: npm-run-all --sequential build:remote:wasm build:c:wasm build:c-simple:wasm build:nim:wasm build:nim:js:release build:haxe:wasm build:haxe:js build:cppia:wasm build:cppia:script
scripts.stage:www:dist: mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/remote/out && cp examples/remote/out/main.js examples/remote/out/main.wasm examples/www/dist/examples/remote/out/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/c-lua/out && cp examples/c-lua/out/main.js examples/c-lua/out/main.wasm examples/www/dist/examples/c-lua/out/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/c-simple/out && cp examples/c-simple/out/main.js examples/c-simple/out/main.wasm examples/www/dist/examples/c-simple/out/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/nim-simple/out/wasm && cp examples/nim-simple/out/wasm/main.js examples/nim-simple/out/wasm/main.wasm examples/www/dist/examples/nim-simple/out/wasm/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/nim-simple/out && cp -r examples/nim-simple/out/js examples/www/dist/examples/nim-simple/out/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/haxe-simple/out/wasm && cp examples/haxe-simple/out/wasm/Main.js examples/haxe-simple/out/wasm/Main.wasm examples/www/dist/examples/haxe-simple/out/wasm/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/haxe-simple/out && cp -r examples/haxe-simple/out/js examples/www/dist/examples/haxe-simple/out/ && rm -rf examples/www/dist/examples/cppia && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/cppia/out/wasm && cp examples/cppia/out/wasm/ScriptableMain.js examples/cppia/out/wasm/ScriptableMain.wasm examples/www/dist/examples/cppia/out/wasm/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/examples/js && cp -r examples/js/* examples/www/dist/examples/js/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/bindings/js/dist && cp -r bindings/js/dist/* examples/www/dist/bindings/js/dist/ && mkdir -p examples/www/dist/lib && cp lib/librl.js lib/librl.wasm examples/www/dist/lib/
scripts.build:all:release: npm run build:librl:release && npm run build:examples:release && vite build && npm run stage:www:dist
